name: tweakcc
hook: Piebald AI's tweakcc (2.5k⭐) patches Claude Code in place — swap individual system-prompt fragments with your own markdown files, add custom themes and thinking-verb sets, unlock private/unreleased features, and cut MCP startup time ~50%. A fast-proliferating fork landscape (syntax-syndicate, PsiClawOps, t2fn variants) confirms widespread adoption in September 2026.

name: Claude Fable 5.1 — 75% Cache Price Cut
hook: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 (Sept 1) with base rates unchanged at $10/$50 per million tokens but cache reads slashed 75% to $0.25/M — the first models to carry mandatory text watermarks under the EU AI Act. Anthropic says the cut can reduce effective agentic-workload costs by up to 45% for apps that cache context heavily.

name: claude-code-system-prompts
hook: Piebald AI's live archive (12.7k⭐, 2k forks) extracts every Claude Code system prompt — all 27 tool descriptions, sub-agent and utility prompts — directly from the compiled binary and publishes within minutes of each release. It reached v2.1.273 on September 15, 618 commits tracking 290 versions; pairs with tweakcc to patch those prompts back in.

name: second-brain-skills
hook: Cole Medin's second-brain-skills turns Claude Code into a persistent knowledge-work partner through progressive skill disclosure — Claude only loads detailed instructions when a topic is relevant to the task. Charlie Automates (8K subs) spotlighted the approach in "Don't Setup a Claude Code Second Brain Until You Watch This", driving a fresh wave of installs this week.

name: OpenCode
hook: The open-source Claude Code counterpart (202K+⭐, 950+ contributors) now supports 75+ model providers including local ones at zero API cost, plus a TUI, desktop app, and VS Code/Cursor extensions. v1.18.31 (Sept 15) restored session model boundaries and improved remote config error handling — active weekly releases keep it competitive.

name: Superpowers for Claude Code
hook: Jesse Vincent's Superpowers (286K⭐, now ranked #12 globally on GitHub) enforces brainstorm → plan → TDD → two-stage review across 14 composable Markdown skills. It's gone cross-agent — working with Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and 20+ other agents — and sits in the official Anthropic Claude Code marketplace.

name: andrej-karpathy-skills
hook: Forrest Chang's single CLAUDE.md file (125K+⭐) distills Karpathy's January 2026 LLM-coding-pitfalls observations into four rules — Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution — that you drop into any project root. The repo spawned a multica-ai fork and dozens of derivatives; it's one of the fastest-growing AI-behavior repos of 2026.

name: Claude-BugHunter
hook: Claude-BugHunter (3.3k⭐) ships 82 skills, 15 slash commands, and 681 disclosed HackerOne-report patterns across 24 vulnerability classes as a single Claude Code plugin for external red-team and bug-bounty work. Enterprise identity and infrastructure attack matrices cover current 2024–2026 CVE chains for M365/Entra, Okta, vCenter, and SSL-VPN appliances.

name: second-brain (stancsz)
hook: The "own your memory, don't rent it" take: stancsz/second-brain is simultaneously a native Claude Code skill and a zero-dependency MCP server over a local SQLite file — clone, run, and any MCP-capable agent gets a full-text knowledge graph in plain markdown you fully control. No cloud account, no external service.

name: Claude Code v2.1.273
hook: Claude Code shipped two consecutive versions in 48 hours: v2.1.272 and v2.1.273 (Sept 15), both tagged "bug fixes and reliability improvements." The agents-radar Sept 15 digest flags an emerging PowerShell tool-delay regression on Windows; the Piebald system-prompt archive confirmed the prompt diff within minutes of the release.

name: Dive into Claude Code (paper)
hook: VILA Lab's academic-grade reverse-engineering of Claude Code (2k⭐) publishes full system-prompt maps, module boundaries, tool inventories, and telemetry analysis alongside a peer-reviewable PDF. Quadrilingual (EN/JA/KO/ZH) and now tracking the KAIROS internal codename and several unreleased tool stubs — the closest thing to an architecture RFC for Claude Code.

name: ai-second-brain (charlie947)
hook: charlie947's skill packages Karpathy's memory idea, Alex Freedman's AI-history organizer, and Greg Isenberg's slash-command workflow into one Claude Code skill that walks any user through building a searchable second brain from their ChatGPT, Claude, and research history — emphasizing existing-export compatibility.

name: awesome-claude-code-toolkit
hook: The most enumerated Claude Code collection on GitHub: 135 agents, 35 curated skills, 42 commands, 176+ plugins, 20 hooks, 15 rules, 7 templates, 14 MCP configs, 26 companion apps, and 52 ecosystem entries in one repo. Useful as a discovery index rather than a curated top-10.

name: awesome-claude-plugins (adoption tracker)
hook: Instead of a static list, this n8n-powered repo automatically harvests plugin-adoption metrics across GitHub repositories to produce a live adoption leaderboard of Claude Code plugins. The automated approach surfaces rising newcomers before manual curation catches them.

name: OpenClaw
hook: OpenClaw (388K⭐, beat React's 10-year star record in 60 days) is an on-device personal AI assistant with messaging-channel integrations — not Claude Code, but it's the most-discussed developer repo this week and pulling engineers toward local-AI-agent patterns that intersect with Claude Code workflows.
